text:
```yaml
name: Publish Widget

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '16'
          always-auth: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: pmeier/pytest-results-action@v0.7.2
        with:
          path: 'coverage/lcov.info'

  deploy:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '16'
          always-auth: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build widget
        run: npm run build

      - name: Deploy to Azure Static Web Apps
        uses: Azure/static-web-apps-deploy@v1
        with:
          app_location: './dist'
          azure_static_web_apps_api_token: ${{ secrets.AZURE_STATIC_WEB_APPS_API_TOKEN }}
          skip_app_build: true
```
